visibleInfo.description: My wife, gentle and somewhat distant

hiddenInfo.description: He died for love of Gretta

biases.gretta: I assume her love is complete and exclusive
biases.michael: He was just a boy from her past
biases.himself: I am a good husband, providing security

innerMonologues.content: The party is in full swing, but I feel... disconnected. As if I'm watching the world through a fog.
Why do I always feel like an outsider at these gatherings? My words feel hollow, as if I'm playing a role.
That look on her face... I've never seen it before. What secrets does she keep from me?
All these years, I've been living in ignorance. The dead are closer than I ever imagined.

hiddenInfo.description: My first love, frozen in time
He will never fully understand my grief

biases.gabriel: He tries, but he cannot comprehend
biases.michael: His love was pure and eternal
biases.herself: I am unfaithful in my heart

innerMonologues.content: The music is lovely, but my mind keeps wandering. There are memories I cannot escape.
That song... it takes me back. I can see him standing there in the snow, so young, so brave.
I have to tell him. He deserves the truth, even if it breaks us both.

biases.gabriel: He will never know the depth of our love

innerMonologues.content: The snow falls softly. I remember... waiting. Always waiting.
The cold doesn't matter. I must see her one last time. Love demands nothing less.
I can hear her voice. She is with me now. In this moment, I am truly alive.
